title: Assurance Quality Record (DL-CLOUDAUDIT-B3 / G-3)
description: Sealed per-artifact QualityRecord: the record counterpart of the frozen QA policy owned by qa_plane.py and human_jury.py. The quality triple (deterministic / automated_judge / human_jury) is carried as three physically separated, closed fields that cannot overwrite each other: each plane field is an object with a 'findings' list (additionalProperties false) and the human_jury field is either null or a signed JURY_VERDICT document. An automated judge can never fill the human field (the module runs every human_jury value through human_jury.assert_not_agent_signed, and a proposal-marked or agent-signed document is refused even when re-tagged JURY_VERDICT), and no model score reaches the gate: final_gate is derived exclusively from the deterministic and human planes (the tested qa_plane.aggregate), so the automated_judge findings are advisory-only and structurally excluded from the gate. A record whose human_jury is null can only report NEEDS_HUMAN_VERDICT or BLOCKED; PASS requires a signed human APPROVE. The schema cannot resolve a finding's layer_id to its declaring plane, so the module (quality_record.py) additionally refuses a finding placed in the wrong plane field, an outcome a plane may not produce, an unsigned human outcome, and a verdict from a non-human plane.

subject_ref.description: The design subject the record describes (job, deliverable or artifact reference).

automated_judge.description: Advisory only. The automated judge's findings never contribute to final_gate; the module computes the gate from the deterministic and human planes alone.

human_jury.description: The signed human verdict, or null before the human gate is reached. The module runs any non-null value through human_jury.assert_not_agent_signed, so an agent-signed or proposal-marked document is refused even when re-tagged.

final_gate.description: Derived by the module from the deterministic and human planes only; the module re-derives it on validation and fails closed on a mismatch, so an automated judge can never supply it.

sha256.description: Lowercase nonzero artifact digest; an all-zero digest is not evidence.

rfc3339.description: RFC3339 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset. The module enforces this with a regex because the installed jsonschema has no date-time checker.

plane_findings.description: One plane's block. Closed: a finding belongs to the plane that produced it and the block cannot carry another plane's findings or any field it does not declare.

finding.description: The per-finding contract shared with assurance-qa-layer.schema.json. Per-plane outcome restrictions and plane-field placement cannot be expressed here without resolving layer_id, so the module enforces them.

outcome.description: Closed vocabulary of the frozen DLDS-F070 policy.

verdict.description: Permitted only in a HUMAN plane; the module enforces it.

jury_verdict.description: A signed human-jury verdict (the assurance-jury-record-v2 root shape). Roots differ in 'kind' and closed property sets from a JURY_PROPOSAL, so a proposal document cannot validate here and the module refuses it by name even when re-tagged.

kind.description: Only a human or a named panel may sign; any agent/model/system kind is refused by the module.
